findings.one_line: The coverage flagship's positioning omits a theorem-level comparison with accepted-bank stat_lmtp_threshold_atom_frontier (a distinct moving-intervention weak-overlap frontier) and gives no relevance sentence for several listed closest literature classes (notably BonviniEtAl2021Review, MaSantAnnaSasakiUra2023WeakOverlap, and HillChaudhuri2025HeavyTail), so the claimed novelty is not yet fully substantiated.
